Commentary.Commentary: Right then! The chase begins.

So, 158 is the Target for the West Indies to go 1-0 up in the series. The pitch seems to be a bit on the slower side and Pakistan do have a good bowling attack. So it will be interesting to see how West Indies approach this chase. All to play for then!

All the West Indian bowlers stuck to their plans and bowled some tight line and lengths, ofcourse, apart from Romario Shepherd who had a day to forget with the ball. Jason Holder was the pick of the bowlers as he took 4 wickets which also included the crucial wicket of Babar Azam. Dwayne Bravo did what he does best in the death overs and did not allow the Pakistani batters to free their arms.

So, Pakistan would be very disappointed with the total they have managed to put on the board. They were 112-1 at one stage after 14 overs, but completely lost their way in the end and could only manage 157 runs. The rain break interrupted Pakistan's advancement. Captain Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan had a very good partnership for the second wicket of 67 runs where they played very smartly. But once Rizwan got out, they completely lost the momentum of the innings. Babar Azam too, got out after getting to his Fifty. No other batter managed to score freely and there was a batting collapse at the end.

OUT! RUN OUT! Top class bowling from Bravo as he finds the block hole and Khan hits it to wide of long on, the batsmen look to come back for the second but the throw from Holder is a really good one. Andre Fletcher whips off the bails at the striker's end and Khan's willow is on the line when the bails come off, so he's out. Pakistan end with 157/8!
Slower, length ball on off, Wasim swings it away to deep square leg as the ball just lands short of Hayden Walsh. The batsmen get one.
Back of a length delivery, heaved to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and straight, Khan digs this one out to deep mid-wicket and runs hard to get the second.

BYE! Slower one outside off, swing and a miss from Wasim, the batsmen run through for a single as the keeper misses the direct hit. Dwayne Bravo then misses to hit the stumps at non-striker's end from 2 yards out!
Takes the pace off the ball and bowls it full around off, Khan hits it to wide of long on for a single.

Full ball, outside off. Mohammad Wasim shuffles across and tries to scoop it over the keeper but fails to middle it and it falls just short of the short fine leg fielder. Mohammad Wasim looks for a run but is sent back.
Who will come in next? Mohammad Wasim it is!

OUT! CAUGHT! Fired into the block hole, Sohaib Maqsood leans into the shot and flat bats it over mid on and into the fence, but wait, Romario Shepherd has pulled thisn one out of thin air! He just puts out his right hand over his head and has taken a beauty! Pakistan are falling apart fats and Jason Holder is on a hat trick.
Commentary.Howout: c Romario Shepherd b Jason Holder

Commentary.Commentary: Who is going to come in next? Shadab Khan it is!
OUT! CAUGHT! Full again, just pushed a bit wider, Hasan Ali looks to whack it out of the ground first delivery but hits it straight to Dwayne Bravo at wide long off. He's gone for a golden duck.
Commentary.Howout: c Dwayne Bravo b Jason Holder

Commentary.Commentary: Full, around off, driven through cover for one.
Review for LBW! The decision has been sent upstairs as West Indies review.

NOT OUT! Full, in swinging delivery, Maqsood looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. Huge shout but not given. Kieron Pollard has taken the review. The replay shows that the wickets are Umpire' call and Maqsood survives.
FOUR! Smart batting from Sohaib Maqsood as he flicks the full ball on middle over square leg and into the fence.
Who will come in at number 7? It's Sohaib Maqsood.

OUT! CAUGHT! On a hat trick now Dwayne Bravo! Very smartly bowled, pushed very wide and full, enticing Fakhar Zaman to hit it over covers and he goes to do just that. But it is just too wide to reach and hence, Zaman gets it off the toe-end of the bat and straight down the throat of Hayden Walsh who takes a simple catch at deep cover.
Commentary.Howout: c Hayden Walsh b Dwayne Bravo

Commentary.Commentary: Who will come in next? Hasan Ali it is!

OUT! CAUGHT! Cheeky Dwayne Bravo at his best! Bangs this one in short but not with a lot of pace, Hafeez fetches it from outside off stump and tries to whack it over the square leg fence, only manages to find Hayden Walsh in the deep.
Commentary.Howout: c Hayden Walsh b Dwayne Bravo

Commentary.Commentary: Full, outside off, hit down the ground to long on for one.
Slower one, pushed wider, Zaman hits it to wide of long on and comes back for the second. Good running.
Right in the block hole, Hafeez digs this one out to deep square leg for a run.
Length ball on middle, Hafeez swings it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Bowling change. Dwayne Bravo is back into the attack.
Did that carry to Dwayne Bravo? Pitched up and driven hard on the up towards mid off, a single is taken. It did carry, so it's a dropped catch!
Length ball outside off, Zaman slashes it towards sweeper cover for a run.
Slower, length delivery aaround off, Hafeez hits it well but Bravo gets a hand to it at covers and stops the boundary. Just a single.
Pushed full and wide, Zaman is able to push it down to long on for a run.
Back of a length on off, Hafeez blocks it onto the deck and gets off the mark with a quick single.

Review for Caught Behind. It seems to be very close, the bat has hit the ground as well as the bowl. There was however a slight edge as the ball went past Babar Azam and the decision has been overturned. Mohammad Hafeez is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Full swinging ball, outside off. Azam looks to tap it on the off side but the ball sneaks underneath his bat. Jason Holder is certain that there is an edge and has taken the review though. Azam did get a faint edge as his bat hit the ground and what a wonderful review, the skipper is dismissed for a well made 51.
Commentary.Howout: c Nicholas Pooran b Jason Holder

Commentary.Commentary: UPDATE 10:05 pm IST - Good news! Rain has stopped and the players are back on. No loss of overs as well.

UPDATE 09:50pm IST - Finally the Umpires feel that the rain is heavy enough that play cannot carry on. The covers are on the ground and we seem to have a rain delay. But, it looks to be just a passing shower and we will be back soon with the latest update.

FOUR! Beautifully worked by Fakhar Zaman as he moves across and fetches this one from outside off and sweeps it past backward square leg for another boundary. The Pakistani batsmen seem to have Romario Shepherd all figured out.
Low full toss on middle, swung away to deep mid-wicket for a run.
SIX! WOW! FIFTY for Babar Azam, full toss on the hips, easily done by Azam as he effortlessly lofts it over the square leg fence for a huge hit. The pressure is on Romario Shepherd.
Misses the yorker again but this time it's driven down to long off for one.
FOUR! THUMPED! Tries to go full and wide again, it's a low full toss and Zaman whacks it over cover and into the fence.
Full again, just outside off, Zaman looks to swing it across but gets beaten.
WIDE! Full ball, pushed outside the tramline. Wide signalled.
LEG BYE! Fakhar Zaman looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. West Indies appeal but the Umpire turns it down. They take one.
Flatter ball, outside off. Driven hard towards long off for one.
Tossed up, on middle. Worked towards the on side for a run. He is off the mark.
Flatter ball, on off. Pushed towards cover for one.

Umpire review for a RUN OUT! Evin Lewis has hit the stumps on the full from mid-wicket even though he could see just the one stump, it's a brilliant piece of individual work. We can see on the replay that Mohammad Rizwan is nowhere near the crease and he's RUN OUT by a mile. Finally the partnership is broken and Fakhar Zaman is the new batsman in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Excellent piece of fielding there by Evin Lewis. Tossed up ball, around off. Babar Azam works it to the on side and they look to take a couple. Evin Lewis comes running in and collects the ball and throws it straight back onto the stumps at the non-striker's end. Mohammad Rizwan is well short of his crease and he has to depart after a well made 46.
Flatter ball, around off. Babar Azam shimmies down and cuts it straight to the backward point fielder.
Full ball, outside off. Babar Azam drives it towards long off for one.
FOUR! Romario goes searching for the yorker but misses his mark and it's a low full toss, around off. Babar Azam swings hard and bisects the deep fielder on the on side for a boundary.
Full ball, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan digs it out towards mid-wicket for a run.
Slower ball, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan pulls it towards deep square leg and Andre Fletcher dives to stop the boundary. They run two.
Low full toss, outside off. Carved towards sweeper cover for one.
Full ball, outside off. Driven to the long on fielder for one.
Bowling change. Romario Shepherd is brought back into the attack.
FOUR! A tad short, around off. Babar Azam rocks back and cuts it late behind backward point for a boundary.
Tossed up, on off. Mohammad Rizwan advances down the track and drives it towards long off for one.
Babar Azam steps down but yorks himself in the process. Gets an inside edge and they take one.
Flighted around off. Driven towards long on for a run.
Tossed up, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan shuffles across to slog sweep but misses.
Tossed up, around leg. Turned towards mid-wicket for one.
Akeal Hosein is done with his quota of 4 overs. Who will replace him? It's going to be Hayden Walsh.
Full ball, on the stumps. Driven towards the long on fielder for a run.
Good length ball, around off. Babar Azam defends it back to the bowler.
length ball, on the pads. Mohammad Rizwan works it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Low full toss, around middle. Babar Azam works it towards long on for a single.
Slower ball, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan waits for it and cuts it towards backward point for one.
Slower ball, on the pads. Flicked towards mid-wicket for a run.
Dwayne Bravo is back for his second spell.
Tossed up, on off. Babar Azam drives it to the long off fielder for a single.
Flatter ball, around off. Mohammad Rizwan shimmies down and plays it towards long off for one.
A tad short around off. Pulled towards short mid-wicket for a run. The fielder half stops it so they take one.
Quicker and flatter, angling in. Babar Azam is cramped for room and defends it awkwardly.
Quicker ball, around middle. Worked towards mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter ball, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan looks to sweep it fine but gets a top edge and the ball falls just short of the bowler.
Well bowled, flatter on top of off, Azam looks to cut but gets cramped for room as he taps it towards point.
SIX! SWEET! Just a tad short and Azam latches onto it, pulls it wide of long on and over the ropes for a maximum.
Walsh sees Rizwan charging and pushes it wider but Rizwan still manages to loft it inside out over covers for a single.
Full and straight, Azam pushes it to long on for a run.
Gives it some air on off, Azam crunches it to Pollard at cover.
Tossed up outside off, slogged down to long on for one by Rizwan.
Tossed up, around off. Babar Azam paddles it behind square on the leg side for another couple of runs.
Short and wide. Babar Azam cuts it hard towards deep point for a couple of runs.
BEATEN! WOW! Flatter ball, around off. Babar Azam gets forward to defend but is beaten on the outside edge as the ball turns sharply.
Flatter ball, on off. Turned towards the on side for one.
Flighted outisde off, driven through covers for a single.
Tossed up around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Flighted around off, pushed through covers for one.
A touch shorter, Azam punches it off the back foot to cover.
Tossed up around off, driven through cover for a single.
A touch shorter, coming in, Azam rocks back and plays it to deep cover for one.
Nicely tossed up, Azam pushes it back onto the non-striker's stumps.
Slightly dragged down, worked to wide long on for one.
Bowling change. Hayden Walsh is into the attack.
Length ball, around off, nudged to third man by Rizwan for a single.
This time it's fuller, on off, Azam drives it down to long on for a run.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Azam. Pitched up on the legs, Azam flicks it into the fine leg boundary.
FOUR! Stand and deliver from Babar Azam. A touch short and worked past short mid-wicket into the gap and into the fence.
Back of a length and Azam pulls it straight to short mid-wicket.
Length ball on off, punched to long on for one.
Bowling change. Romario Shepherd is into the attack.
Pitched up on off, driven straight to mid off. Pakistan are 55/1 at the end of the POWERPLAY!
Off paced delivery outside off, Rizwan bunts it cover and takes a quick single.
Length ball on top of off, worked to deep mid-wicket for one and Azam is off the mark.
Full and straight, Rizwan leans into his shot and drives it to long on for a single.
Pitched up on off, pushed to mid off.
FOUR! Starts off with a gentle wide one, Rizwan cuts it through the cover region and into the boundary. 50 up for Pakistan!
Who will bowl the final over of the Powerplay? It's going to be Dwayne Bravo.
Slower ball, around middle and leg. Worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
LEG BYE! Good length ball, on the pads. Babar Azam looks to flick but misses. Gets hit on the pads and the ball rolls away to short fine leg. They take a quick single.
Who will come in at number 3? It's the skipper, Babar Azam. Kieron Pollard is also back on the field after receiving some treatment on his fingers.
OUT! CAUGHT! Length ball, around off. Sharjeel Khan looks to loft it over the mid on fielder but fails to get any elevation and it goes straight to Akeal Hosein at mid on.
Commentary.Howout: c Akeal Hosein b Jason Holder

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Back of a length ball, around off. Sharjeel Khan pulls it over the deep mid-wicket region for a maximum. Clean strike this!
Full ball, angling in a bit. Sharjeel Khan digs it towards mid-wicket.
Length ball, outside off. Pushed towards sweeper cover for one.
Bowling change. Jason Holder is back from the opposite end.
Flatter ball, on leg. Worked towards the on side for a single.

A huge shout for LBW, but the Umpire turns it down. It was full and around off, Rizwan went down on his knees trying to sweep but missed it onto the pads. West Indies players do not take a review after some discussion.
FOUR! Low full toss, around middle and leg. Mohammad Rizwan sweeps it fine towards deep square leg for a boundary.
WIDE! Too wide outside off. Mohammad Rizwan shuffles across to slog but leaves it at the end. Called wide.
DROPPED! Short ball, outside off. Sharjeel Khan punches it hard and Kieron Pollard drops it at cover. They take one.
WIDE! Another one sprayed down the leg side again. Sharjeel Khan leaves it alone. Called wide.
WIDE! Sprayed down the leg side. Called wide.
Tossed up, on off. Driven towards long on for a run.
Flatter ball, on middle. Sharjeel Khan pulls it towards long on and it falls just short of the fielder. They take one.
Bowling change. Chris Gayle is in to roll his arms.
Short ball, around leg. Sharjeel Khan pulls it fine towards square leg for one.
Flatter ball, around off. Mohammad Rizwan works it towards the on side for a single.
Quicker ball, on middle. Mohammad Rizwan shimmies down again and looks to slog but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg.

SIX! BACK TO BACK SIXES! Flatter ball, around off. Mohammad Rizwan shimmies down the track and hits it over the bowler's head for another maximum. It's been called a No Ball as well and it's Free Hit time!
SIX! SMASHED! Short ball, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan pulls it hard wide of the long on fielder for a biggie.
Darted in, around off. Mohammad Rizwan blocks it off the back foot.
Quicker ball, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan looks to sweep but misses.
FOUR! Length ball, on off. Sharjeel Khan lofts it over mid-wicket with authority for a boundary.
Length bal, on middle. Sharjeel Khan heaves it straight towards mid-wicket fielder.
Good length ball, around off. Sharjeel Khan defends it uppishly towards cover.
Full and swinging ball, outside off. Sharjeel Khan shoulders arms.
FOUR! Full ball, strayed on the pads. Sharjeel Khan whips it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Starts with a full toss, on middle. Pushed to mid off.
Who will bowl from the other end? It's going to be Jason Holder.
Quicker ball, on middle. Sharjeel Khan works it towards the on side for one.
Flatter ball, around leg. Mohammad Rizwan tucks it towards square leg for a run.
Short ball, around leg. Worked towards square leg for one.
Quicker ball, on off. Mohammad Rizwan pushes it towards long on off the back foot for a single.
A tad short, outside off. Sharjeel Khan pulls it towards the deep mid-wicket fielder for one. He is off the mark.
Starts with a flatter ball, outside off. Sharjeel Khan pushes it towards mid off.

So, we are ready for play in this 2nd T20I between West Indies and Pakistan. The West Indian players have spread out on the field and the Pakistani openers are in the middle, Sharjeel Khan and Mohammad Rizwan. Akeal Hosein has been given the new ball.

Hasan Ali is down for a chat. He says in rain affected game batters usually go hard at the bowlers so he went with his slower balls in the first T20I. On reaching 50 T20I wickets he says he is happy and looking forward to play well for his country. He also states that he is working hard on his batting and wants to become an allrounder for his country. He feels that West Indies have a powerful batting line-up but they are well prepared for it.

Babar Azam, Pakistan Captain, says they are familiar with the conditions and looking forward to playing in Guyana. He also praises the Young Pace Bowler Mohammad Wasim Jr by saying he is a very good and talented bowler. Pakistan have been forced to make one change, Azam Khan misses out due to an injury and he is replaced by Sohaib Maqsood.

Kieron Pollard elects to bowl first, says that there is some moisture which will be helpful for the bowlers. He is happy that fans are back in the stadium and mentions that they have made two changes, Andre Fletcher in for Lendl Simmons and Romario Shepherd in for Andre Russell.

Pakistan (PLAYING XI) - Sharjeel Khan, Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Babar Azam (C), Mohammad Hafeez, Fakhar Zaman, Sohaib Maqsood (In for Azam Khan), Shadab Khan, Hasan Ali, Mohammad Wasim, Shaheen Afridi, Usman Qadir.

West Indies (PLAYING XI) - Evin Lewis, Andre Fletcher (In for Lendl Simmons), Chris Gayle, Shimron Hetmyer, Nicholas Pooran (WK), Kieron Pollard (C), Jason Holder, Dwayne Bravo, Romario Shepherd (In for Andre Russell), Hayden Walsh, Akeal Hosein.
TOSS - Time for the toss and West Indies have won the toss, they have elected to FIELD FIRST!

Hello and Welcome to one and all for the 2nd T20I which will be played at Guyana between West Indies and Pakistan. In the first match, rain played spoilsport at Barbados and we did not get any result. So, all eyes will be on this T20I which promises to be a cracker as both these teams would be raring to go. It will be interesting to see who comes out on top. Stay tuned for the toss and playing XI.
